annotations.title: Yearly deadlines of a business in Poland

description: Use for the yearly tax, ZUS, VAT and reporting deadlines of a business. Calendar of tax, ZUS, VAT, payroll and reporting deadlines for a calendar year: monthly PIT/CIT advances or ryczałt, own ZUS, JPK_V7M, PIT and ZUS of employees, PPK, annual returns, annual health contribution, CIT-8, financial statements and JPK files. Dates are computed from statutory rules with the shift to the next working day; event-based duties (CRBR, ZUS registration, invoices) are listed as facts.

form.description: Business form: sole proprietorship on tax scale, flat 19% or lump-sum ryczałt, or limited company.

vat_payer.description: Active VAT payer (monthly JPK_V7M), default false.

year.description: Calendar year, default the current one.
